notes: οὕτως takes the whole correlative 'even so' headed on 'so' and the answering καί is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing no 'also' (rules 65 and 100) — the same reading as 5:18 and 5:19.
τῷ before θανάτῳ is `unrepresented` for want of an English determiner, the case preposition staying with the noun (rules 21 and 23); τοῦ before κυρίου is displaced by ἡμῶν → 'our' (rule 20).
